metadata.descripcion: Tech job offers reviewed by the community, and talent profiles.

inicio.titulo: The tech job board is under construction.
inicio.descripcion: Job offers reviewed by our staff and talent profiles from the community.

componentes.descripcion: Internal catalogue for the team: this is how the job board components look. Change one and it changes everywhere.
componentes.campoNombreAyuda: This is what companies will see.
componentes.campoGithubError: That link is not a GitHub link.
componentes.tarjetaTexto: The base box for job offers, profiles and forms.

ofertas.ayudaIdiomas: You will only see job offers that ask for languages on this list.
ofertas.ocultas: {count, plural, one {There is # more job offer that asks for {idioma}.} other {There are # more job offers that ask for {idioma}.}}
ofertas.vacio: There are no matching job offers right now. Come back soon: the staff reviews new ones every day.
ofertas.error: We couldn't load the job offers. Please try again in a moment.
ofertas.vacioConFiltros: No job offers match these filters. Try removing some.
ofertas.faltanIdiomas: {count, plural, one {This offer requires {idiomas}, which is not among the languages you speak.} other {This offer requires {idiomas}, which are not among the languages you speak.}}
ofertas.sinDescripcion: The company hasn't published more details. You'll find them on their website.
ofertas.aplicarAyuda: You apply to {empresa} on their own website. TechToJob doesn't store your data.
ofertas.tituloConTotal: {count, plural, =0 {No tech job offers} one {# tech job offer} other {# tech job offers}}
ofertas.aplicarAyudaCorta: Opens their website. TechToJob doesn't store your data.
ofertas.portadaTexto: No ghost jobs, no endless portals: the staff reviews every offer before it goes live. And you only see the ones that ask for languages you speak.

revision.titulo: Every offer is checked by the staff
revision.idiomas: It says which languages it requires

ofertas.tituloSeccion: {count, plural, =0 {No job offers} one {# job offer} other {# job offers}}

filtros.ver: {count, plural, =0 {No job offers} one {Show # job offer} other {Show # job offers}}

noEncontrada.texto: The job offer may no longer be published, or the link may be incomplete.

tema.cambiar: Switch between light and dark mode

buscador.ejemplo: Search by role, company or technology: data engineer, React…

cuenta.mismoEmail: If you log in with Google and GitHub using the same email, it's the same account.

discord.porQue: Link your Discord so we know you're part of the TechToJob community. We only see your username; Discord can't be used to log in.
discord.fueraServidor: You're not in the TechToJob server yet. Join and check again.
discord.errorVincular: Couldn't link Discord. Please try again.
discord.errorNoResponde: Discord isn't responding right now. Try again later.

entrar.texto: With your Google or GitHub account. No password needed.
entrar.privacidad: We only store your name, email and photo. You can link your Discord later, in My account.

errores.discord_solo_vincular: You can't log in with Discord. Log in with Google or GitHub and link Discord in My account.
errores.account_not_linked: There's already an account with that email. Log in the way you did the first time.
errores.otro: Couldn't log in. Please try again.

navegacion.irALanding: TechToJob: go to the community website

pie.lema: The TechToJob community job board: tech job offers reviewed by the staff.

talento.entradilla: Profiles of the TechToJob people: their stack, their level, whether they're looking for a job and what they've built. So companies get to know you before the interview.

puntos.disponibilidad: Whether you're job hunting, open to offers or freelancing
puntos.proyectos: Projects and tournaments you've taken part in
puntos.visibilidad: You decide who sees it: everyone, registered users only or nobody

talento.mientrasTexto: Introduce yourself on the Discord: share your stack and what you're learning. When profiles open, you'll already have context in the community.

staff.entradilla: Review offers before they go live on the job board. Only staff can see this.
staff.nuevaEntradilla: It stays pending. Then you review and publish it like the others.
staff.revisaCampos: Check the fields marked in red.
staff.errorGeneral: It couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment.

lista.yaNoSale: No longer on the job board

detalle.verEnLaBolsa: See it on the job board

comprobaciones.empresa: The company exists and is who it says it is
comprobaciones.enlace: The link works and leads to this offer

acciones.marcaTodas: Tick the three checks to publish.
acciones.alargarAyuda: If the company is still hiring. Added to the time it had left.
acciones.cerrarAyuda: Removes it from the job board (no longer hiring or the link is broken).

hecho.publicar: Published. It will be on the job board for 45 days.
hecho.cerrar: Closed. It's no longer on the job board.

form.urlOriginalAyuda: Where people apply. Check that it works.
form.idiomaAyuda: To warn people reading it in another language.
form.resumenAyuda: One or two sentences. It's the first thing people read.
form.descripcionAyuda: Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
form.tecnologiasAyuda: The ones the offer asks for. {max} at most.
form.salarioAyuda: Optional, but offers with a salary work better.
form.idiomasQuePideAyuda: People who don't speak them won't see the offer in their list. Tick at least one.

errores.url: It must be a web address (https://…).
errores.desconocida: There's a technology we don't know.
errores.codigo: It must be a 2-letter code (ES, PT…).
errores.numero: It must be a whole number.
errores.menor: It must be greater than or equal to “From”.
errores.idioma: There's a language we don't know.
errores.nivel: There's a language level we don't know.

empresaId.falta: Choose the company or create a new one.

ciudad.falta: If it's not remote, add the city or the country.

remotoDesde.falta: Choose where it can be done remotely from.

accion.comprobaciones: Tick the three checks before publishing.
accion.motivo: Write why it isn't published (3 to 300 characters).
accion.estado: This offer is no longer published.
accion.sin_permiso: You no longer have access to the staff panel.
accion.desconocido: It couldn't be done. Try again.
